lcc_original: 人類開始在地上增多起來，又生着女兒。
notes: H02490 (חֵחֵל, 'began'): implicit in UNV {<WH02490>}{<WTH8689>} but LCC has explicit 開始 — per Rule 3, braces dropped and tags attached directly to 開始.
H03588 (כִּי, 'when'): explicit as 當 in UNV but LCC restructures the clause as a plain statement with no temporal marker — made implicit {<WAH03588>}.
H01961 (וַיְהִי, 'and it came to pass'): implicit in both UNV and LCC — retained as {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} at sentence start.
Trailing {<WAH09001>} from UNV's 的時候 construction (marking waw on וּבָנוֹת) has no explicit LCC counterpart — kept implicit before sentence-final 。.
人類 (LCC) maps to 人 (UNV) for H0120 (הָאָדָם, 'mankind'); LCC's more formal compound is semantically equivalent.
地上 (LCC) maps to 世上 (UNV) for H06440+H0127 (פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה, 'face of the ground').
